about.en: This WOJAK is a community-run Ethereum memecoin inspired by the Wojak ("Feels Guy") internet meme, promoted at wojakcto.com. It is the ERC-20 at 0x8De39B057CC6522230AB19C0205080a8663331Ef on Ethereum. It is a different token from Wojak Coin (wojak-coin, 0x5026F006B85729a8b14553FAE6af249aD16c9aaB) and from several other WOJAK-ticker tokens, and trades at a far lower unit price.
